items.title: Fractional rings of tangent spheres
items.summary: Soddy’s hexlet consists of a ring of six spheres, tangent to each other consecutively around the ring, and another ring of three consecutively-tangent spheres, so that all the spheres in the first ring are tangent to all the spheres in the second ring. items.title: Non-coplanar unit distances
items.summary: Reports that LLMs have killed the Erdős unit distance problem turn out to be greatly exaggerated. There is still plenty not yet understood about the problem.
